** [[Lebanon|Lebanese]] [[Prime minister|PM]] [[Fouad Siniora]] has accused [[Israel]] of a "naked violation" of the five-day-old [[ceasefire]], after a raid by Israeli commandos deep inside [[Lebanon]].
